I mean, Burbank and the Oasis would be fine, but would Dolls from other sectors even be interested in idols?

units.rawText: Well, things might not be as bad as you think. Here, have a look.

spans.text: Nanaka holds up her terminal, and an electronic invitation springs up from it.

units.rawText: We cordially invite the members of 4You to hold a concert in Cyclopes... signed, "An Agent from Cyclopes?"

units.rawText: Whoever did this didn't leave their real name... And it isn't an official Cyclopes email...

units.rawText: Mm... It's the most recent invitation I received.

units.rawText: Seems more like a scheme than an invitation to me.

units.rawText: Cyclopes is a sector for researching and testing military material, right? I'm fairly sure the environment must be quite similar to a real-world military camp...

units.rawText: From my experience, the army is about as far away as you can get from idols.

units.rawText: The concert might end up becoming a brawl instead. What should we do then, Leader~

units.rawText: If the fans call, we idols must answer. Scheme or not, we need to go to Cyclopes and see what's going on.
